Now we could use the same technique that we had previously used for loading up config files where we did something like Cube CTL apply dash F.

So we could do something like K8s and then it was the first one called client deployment.
But there's actually a little shortcut that we can use any time that we want to apply a group of configuration files.

And then I can apply every file inside there with apply dash F and I'm just going to provide the K8s directory.
